phrases.es: A kilo of apples, please.
Two kilos of potatoes, please.
How much are the oranges?
Three bananas, please.
One onion and two tomatoes, please.
phrases.ru: Одну луковицу и два помидора, пожалуйста.

phrases.es: That's very expensive.
Are the strawberries cheap today?
Can I have a bag, please?
I want to buy two lemons.
How much does the lettuce cost?
Can I have a kilo of carrots?
Have you got any garlic?
Half a kilo of cherries, please.
phrases.note: «Half a kilo» — артикль стоит после «half»: не «a half kilo».

phrases.es: Where are these peaches from?
Are the mushrooms fresh?
Can I taste it?
What fruit is in season now?
That's all, thank you.
Can you weigh these grapes?
Keep the change.
Excuse me, who's last in the queue?
Are these tomatoes organic?
If you make it cheaper, I'll take it.
This peach is rotten.
Do you sell beans loose?
phrases.ru: У вас есть фасоль на развес?

phrases.es: Where does this cheese come from?
That's a real bargain!
He didn't mean to hurt you.
I understand that you are angry.
What if you weigh the tomatoes together?
Don't take it to heart, love.
phrases.ru: Не принимай близко к сердцу, дорогуша.

phrases.es: Please do not take it to heart, madam.
phrases.ru: Пожалуйста, не принимайте это близко к сердцу, мадам.

phrases.es: A sign won't fix the echo.
Good idea, put it up by the entrance.
phrases.ru: Хорошая идея, повесь её у входа.

phrases.es: What if you write it with a bit of humour?
phrases.ru: А если написать её с юмором?
